card.name: Linking words in blood glucose testing
card.fires_on: Small linking or punctuation tokens (with, or, comma, parenthesis, slash) right after a glucose test or glycemic control term, in label text about glucose monitoring.

modes.label: 'with' after glycemic control
modes.description: The word 'with' following 'Monitoring glycemic control' in drug-interaction lab test entries.
modes.example: Intervention Monitoring glycemic control<< with>> urine glucose tests is not recommended in patients

modes.label: Punctuation in FPG/HbA1c lists
modes.description: A bracket, slash, comma or 'or' right after fasting glucose or HbA1c abbreviations in pre-treatment testing instructions.
modes.example: Before initiating treatment with VIJOICE, test fasting plasma glucose (FPG<<),>> HbA1c, and optimize

card.plain: It fires on small connecting words and marks right after blood sugar test names in monitoring instructions.
